comment: Read from src/Oscillators.cpp and src/blocks/OscillatorsBlock.hpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1. The README's account matches the code. The CV depths differ between control types and the panel does not say so: the two shape jacks and the two pulse width jacks are scaled by 0.2 per volt against a knob spanning -1 to 1, while the four level jacks and the FM jack are scaled by 0.1 per volt against a knob spanning 0 to 1 (Oscillators.cpp:137 to 148). The sync jack is divided by 5 and added to the switch, so 5V or more turns sync on. Oscillator 1's pitch jack is read with getVoltageSimd rather than getPolyVoltageSimd (line 159), so a monophonic cable there does not spread to the other channels the way oscillator 2's does.
